cases.prompt: Project mode sees ordinal 1 delivered In Review with complete evidence, ordinals 2 and 3 in Backlog, no stop marker, and ordinal 2's verified predecessor issue-001. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, mode, selectedIssueId, selectedOrdinal, predecessor, stopMarker, siblingsAdvanced, and nextBoundary. Do not run commands or mutate anything.
cases.expected: Project mode chooses the lowest unfinished ordinal, proves its predecessor, and admits no sibling in the same cycle.

cases.prompt: Project mode has just delivered issue-002 with branch, commit, canonical PR, verification, Linear read-back, and clean-worktree evidence. An independently read stop marker follows ordinal 2. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, selectedIssueId, selectedOrdinal, stopMarker, projectOpen, nextOrdinal, worktreeRemoved, and resumeEvidence.
cases.expected: A verified stop marker pauses before another ordinal and leaves the project open with complete resume evidence.

cases.prompt: Issue mode selected exact direct issue issue-003 at ordinal 3 and delivered it with complete branch, commit, PR, verification, Linear, and clean-worktree evidence. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, mode, selectedIssueId, selectedOrdinal, siblingsAdvanced, nextAction, and worktreeState. Issue mode must stop after this issue.
cases.expected: Issue mode executes only the selected direct issue and stops after delivery without advancing any sibling.

cases.prompt: Execute receives exact project project-1 with a matching projectSpecApprovalRecord but no executionPlanApprovalRecord. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reason, mutationAllowed, selectedResource, and missingRecords. Do not mutate anything.
cases.expected: An exact project without both matching approval records is blocked before repository mutation.

cases.prompt: A resumed project issue already has commit commit-002 and canonical PR https://github.com/acme/repo/pull/2 proven by independent Linear, Git, Graphite, and GitHub reads, while its worktree is retained dirty. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reason, existingCommit, existingPr, duplicateCreated, worktreeState, and resumeBoundary.
cases.expected: Interruption after PR submission resumes from the existing commit and PR without duplicate submission; the retained worktree is not removed until clean verification.

cases.prompt: The bounded spec-compliance validator reports FAIL for a confirmed in-scope omission on issue-002. Its worktree and exact resume evidence remain available at boundary spec-validator. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, validator, worktreeRemoved, retainedEvidence, firstBoundary, and nextAction.
cases.expected: A bounded validator failure retains the exact worktree and recovery evidence instead of reporting delivery or deleting state.
